dct_title_s: Le cours du Danube depuis sa source jusqu'a ses embouchures / dressé sur les memoires les plus nouveaux du P. Coroneli et autres par le Sr. Sanson presenté a Monseigneur le Dauphin.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Includes 2 insets, one of the Principality of Fürstenberg showing the source of Danube (scale approximately 1:220,000), and one of the Bosphorus and Constantinople (scale approximately 1:280,000).; Included are also 5 city views of Varadin (Oradea, Romania), Canise Kanjiža (Serbia), Temeswar (Timișoara, (Romania), Sigeth (Sighet, Romania) and Belgrade (Serbia).; Appears in: Atlas nouveau, contenant toutes les parties du monde.- - Paris : Hubert Jaillot, 1692.
1 map : illustrations, hand colored 43 x 118 cm, sheet 62 x 130 cm
dct_creator_sm: Jaillot, Alexis Hubert, 1632?-1712. Atlas nouveau, contenant toutes les parties du monde
dct_subject_sm: Danube River Region Maps Early works to 1800.
